item.description:
New in 0.1.3

  • Runs natively on Intel Macs. TimeCal is now a universal app: Apple Silicon and Intel, each with full native code.
  • The Now toggle. The playhead gets its own control: click Now (or press N) to center the red bar; while lit, Day, Week, and Month zoom around it, and it stays pinned dead-center through the animation. Press T any time to jump to today, midnight-left.
  • Richer color. Event blocks and their titles are noticeably more saturated and higher-contrast, and tentative events' hatching is calmer so titles stay readable.
  • Snappier flights. Zoom animations launch harder and settle softer.
  • Small things. The Ungrouped calendar section collapses; stacked rows wait longer before growing taller; toolbar buttons carry labels for icon-and-text mode.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@sandpipermediagroup.com.
